jurisdiction_name: WEST JEFFERSON WARD4 (WEST JEFFERSON VILLAGE Village)
narrative: West Jefferson Ward4 (Village of West Jefferson Village) has 540 registered voters, with 56.5% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 30.0% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 13.5%, a pronounced Republican lean of 16.5 percentage points.
